notes.title: Neon Drive v1.7 – Compatibility Update + A Glimpse Into the Future
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We've just rolled out Neon Drive v1.7, and while it's not a content update, it brings a couple of improvements and a little surprise for fans of retrofuturistic vibes.[/p][p][/p][h3]Updated to Unity 6[/h3][p]We’ve upgraded the game engine to the latest version of Unity to ensure better compatibility with modern systems — especially for players on [b]64-bit macOS[/b]. This should improve stability and [b]future-proof[/b] Neon Drive for years to come.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Tease of What’s Next[/h3][p]If you leave Neon Drive idle for a bit, you might notice something new...[/p][p]We’ve added an in-game trailer for our upcoming spiritual successor: Neon Hyperdrive.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24678934/4c133a55fc0e752d97916cd0857924016ed01d70.gif"][/img][/p][p]You’ll also find a brand-new arcade machine in the main menu — right after all the levels — marked “Under Construction.”[/p][p]Above it, two mysterious buttons have appeared:[/p][list][*][p]Watch Trailer[/p][/*][*][p]Visit Steam Page[/p][/*][/list][p]Clicking the latter takes you straight to Neon Hyperdrive’s Coming Soon page, where you can wishlist it if you're curious about what we’ve been building all these years.[/p][p][/p][p]If by any chance the new update doesn't work well on your system and the previous build did, please let us know. In the meantime, you can safely opt out and choose the previous build v1.60 in the game's properties -> Betas.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24678934/c0d4e11e6e5596e2f902cf02babe25cfcf4a42bb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks as always for playing Neon Drive. Your support has meant the world to us, and we're thrilled to finally share a glimpse of the next chapter.[/p][p][/p][p]The Neon Team[/p]

notes.title: New Game - Neon Hyperdrive Is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Neon Drive fans! 👋[/p][p]We’ve got some exciting news – our new game, [b]Neon Hyperdrive[/b], is officially on the way, and the [b]Steam page is now live[/b]![/p][p]
👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3422100/Neon_Hyperdrive/" style="button" buttoncolor="#151555"]Check it out and wishlist here[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24678934/554827034c224d2c816fc9d4bda7dfdc6a3104cf.gif"][/img][/p][p]If you loved the music, style, and challenge of [i]Neon Drive[/i], you’re going to love what we’ve got in store. [i]Neon Hyperdrive[/i] is a [b]spiritual successor[/b] that takes things to the next level:[/p][list][*][p]⚡ Fast-paced, music-driven gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]🎶 A brand-new original soundtrack[/p][/*][*][p]🌌 A neon-drenched sci-fi world[/p][/*][*][p]🚗 More rhythm-infused action than ever before - dodge, drift, shoot and more![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24678934/59ff7f5466db73fe3a5b17321fa340bc70f28a9d.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to share more with you soon. In the meantime, [b]please wishlist the game[/b] – it helps more players discover it and ensures you’ll be the first to know when it launches.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all your support – and for riding with us again 💜
— The [i]Neon Hyperdrive[/i] Dev Team[/p]

- Minor bugfixes.

notes.title: Neon Drive for Linux too!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24678934/ac7d04fc4d5330efc04fcbd4e508a7ce08170a2e.png[/img]


Neon Drive is now available for Linux/SteamOS, identical to the Windows and Mac versions. The game is available on all platforms for its existing and future owners.

To celebrate the Linux launch, Neon Drive will be available on Steam at a 45% discount for 8 days, from Saturday February 11, to Sunday February 19.

As a bonus for Windows users, the new update has solved the XBox wireless controller issues.

notes.title: Rhythm Game Neon Drive Is All The 80s You Can Take
notes.notes:
Super Hexagon and Audiosurf walk into a bar. Except they realize the bar is a disco, and it’s having a Tron-themed party. Only neons light up the room. They’re playing Europe, obnoxiously loud, and the best dancer will win an actual DeLorean. So they dance like they come from out of this world, and leave the real one far behind.

That’s about the kind of scenario that could give birth to Neon Drive [official site] a tough-as-nails rhythm game in which you need to use your car (or plane) to avoid obstacles. The devs are even handing out Certificates of Superhuman Abilities to whoever manages to collect all the achievements.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Game Update - Music Sync, Practice Mode, Extra Life
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24678934/4de560962f53802051ee3cca965a4193dae6ede5.png[/img]

After considering all of your valuable feedback, we've updated the game to make it even more enjoyable. The difficulty of the normal mode has been reduced a bit, making the game more approachable to the non-hard-core gaming audience, but we still kept it extra-challenging at higher difficulties.

[list]
    [*]Normal mode is now slightly easier, and you get one extra life.
    [*]We've added practice mode with unlimited lives. You'll love the looks of it (hint: it's another tribute to the '80s). Please note that you'll have to complete the previous level at normal difficulty to unlock the practice mode for the current level.
    [*]Music track offset has been adjusted to be in sync with the visuals; this should eliminate problems on some PC setups.
    [*]We've added an option to manually adjust music offset, in case you find the above fixes don't quite cut it on your setup.
    [*]We've improved many translations, so you can enjoy the game in your language even more. A big thank you to all of our fans that helped with that! You're awesome!
[/list]    

As mentioned, Hard and Insane modes remain unchanged.

Thanks again for all your feedback! We hope you'll enjoy the new features.
